title: 1985 FJ60 -> 6.0 Liter LS Swap Build Thread
ai_summary: 1985 FJ60 swapped with a 6.0L LQ4 (pulled from a Chevy 2500 Express van with ~70,000 miles) paired to a rebuilt 4L65E automatic, retaining the stock FJ60 transfer case via a custom transmission-to-transfer-case adapter. The original 2F/3FE petrol engine made roughly 140hp; no dyno figures were reported for the LS. Cooling was the biggest headache, later resolved with a larger dual-pass radiator.

complications.detail: Initial CSF radiator/dual SPAL fan setup ran 210-220F under load; replaced with a Griffin 31x19x3 dual-pass radiator and 160-degree thermostat, bringing steady temps down to 170-175F
Front driveshaft clearance to the transmission, exhaust, and oil pan was tight; required oil pan modification and moving the engine forward in the bay
